body.statement: For every finite \(G\), every \(0<\alpha<1\), and every \(y\in\mathcal M_n(G)\), the selected certified procedure satisfies \[\Pr_{\mathcal D_G}\!\left\{\tau_n\in\mathcal C_\alpha(G,Z,Y^{\mathrm{obs}})\mid G\right\}\ge1-\alpha.\] On the high-probability event in Theorem 1, its radius is at most \(C^{1/2}d_n/\sqrt{\alpha n\log(d_n+1)}\), which converges to zero throughout the admissible regime.
body.justification: The risk certificate yields finite-sample design-based coverage under endpoint second moments alone, where Wald conditions and fourth moments are unavailable.
body.gap: KandirosEtAl2024ConflictGraph develops Wald intervals under additional moment and dependency restrictions, while HarshawMiddletonSavje2026OptimizedVariance optimizes conservative quadratic variance bounds for fixed linear estimators rather than the attained minimax procedure.
body.consumer: The next random-regular public-goods experiment receives a precomputable honest error bar for the full all-free versus all-fixed policy contrast.
